chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya bin Imran al-Ash'ari, that he said: I was told by Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Hussain bin Khalid, from Abu'l-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who bequeathed a part of his property. He said: A seventh of his third.
ai.seo_question: What is the default share of an estate if a person bequeaths 'a part' of their property?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the legal maxim that the indefinite term 'a part' (جزء) in bequests defaults to one-seventh of one-third of the total estate, a specific ruling distinguishing it from the general one-third limit. This interpretation reflects the Shia jurisprudential approach to resolving ambiguity in testate succession, ensuring that the heir's share is preserved while honoring the testator's intent. The ruling underscores the precision required in Islamic inheritance law to prevent disputes among heirs.
